channel.title: Ivanti — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Ivanti (ivanti).

item.title: CVE-2026-83528 · 4.9 MEDIUM
item.description: Exposure of PII in Ivanti EPMM before version 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to leak GDPR protected user information.

item.title: CVE-2026-107405 · 5.5 MEDIUM
item.description: An exposed dangerous function in Ivanti EPMM before version 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a local authenticated attacker to trigger a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-107404 · 4.9 MEDIUM
item.description: Argument injection in Ivanti EPMM before version 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to delete arbitrary files on disk.

item.title: CVE-2026-105427 · 4.9 MEDIUM
item.description: Improper input validation in Ivanti EPMM before version 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to permanently disable all Apache HTTPS services resulting in denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-105426 · 6.7 MEDIUM
item.description: Improper input validation in Ivanti EPMM before version 12.11.0.0, 12.10.0.1, and 12.9.0.3 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to set arbitrary Linux kernel parameters as root.

item.title: CVE-2026-123181 · 5.5 MEDIUM
item.description: A path traversal vulnerability in Ivanti Sentry before versions 11.0, 10.8.3, and 10.7.4 allows a remote authenticated attacker with administrative privileges to create arbitrary directories and files with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-123179 · 5.5 MEDIUM
item.description: An insecure default initialization of resource in the Tomcat shutdown listener of Ivanti Sentry before versions 11.0, 10.8.3, and 10.7.4 allows a local authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service.

item.title: CVE-2026-105669 · 6.7 MEDIUM
item.description: Argument injection in Ivanti Sentry before version 11.0, 10.8.3, and 10.7.4 allows a remote authenticated attacker with admin privileges to execute arbitrary on-disk binaries.

item.title: CVE-2026-105425 · 7.2 HIGH

item.title: CVE-2026-121683 · 9.4 CRITICAL 🌩️
item.description: Missing authentication in Ivanti Cloud Services Application version 5.0.8 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to add and delete arbitrary trusted EPM Core certificate entries.

item.title: CVE-2026-18128 · 6.8 MEDIUM 🌩️
item.description: Cleartext transmission of sensitive information in the Agent of Ivanti Endpoint Manager before version 2024 SU8 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to in a MITM position to read and modify HTTP traffic.

item.title: CVE-2026-121653 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️

item.title: CVE-2026-105813 · 6.3 MEDIUM

item.title: CVE-2026-118527 · 4.3 MEDIUM 💥
item.description: Use of predictable filenames in Ivanti Connect Secure before versions 25.1.1.3 and 22.8R2.6 allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk.

item.title: CVE-2026-109412 · 9.9 CRITICAL

item.title: CVE-2026-106047 · 7.7 HIGH
